<?php 
/*
Plugin Name: SRS flashcards
Plugin URI: https://kites.dev/wp-learning-cards
Description: A plugin to create and manage learning cards for educational content.
Version: 1.2.2
Author: Guy Landau
Author URI: https://hebleo.com
License: GPL2
*/
// Exit if accessed directly
if ( ! defined( 'ABSPATH' ) ) {
    exit;
}

// Define constants
define( 'WP_LEARNING_CARDS_VERSION', '1.2.2' );
define( 'WP_LEARNING_CARDS_DIR', plugin_dir_path( __FILE__ ) );
define( 'WP_LEARNING_CARDS_URL', plugin_dir_url( __FILE__ ) );

// Include necessary files
require_once WP_LEARNING_CARDS_DIR . 'includes/menu.php';
require_once WP_LEARNING_CARDS_DIR . 'includes/ordering.php';
require_once WP_LEARNING_CARDS_DIR . 'includes/bulk.php';
require_once WP_LEARNING_CARDS_DIR . 'includes/card_templates.php';
require_once WP_LEARNING_CARDS_DIR . 'includes/note_types.php';
require_once WP_LEARNING_CARDS_DIR . 'includes/note_types_templates.php';
require_once WP_LEARNING_CARDS_DIR . 'includes/styles.php';
require_once WP_LEARNING_CARDS_DIR . 'includes/cards.php';
require_once WP_LEARNING_CARDS_DIR . "includes/browse.php";
require_once WP_LEARNING_CARDS_DIR . 'includes/shortcodes.php';
require_once WP_LEARNING_CARDS_DIR . 'includes/metabox.php';
require_once WP_LEARNING_CARDS_DIR . 'templates/card_loader.php';
require_once WP_LEARNING_CARDS_DIR . 'includes/csv.php';


// Menu ordering is handled in includes/menu.php (Browse Cards is the main landing page).

// Ensure /decks works reliably (CPT archive + explicit rewrite rule).
add_action('init', function() {
    // The CPT registration already sets has_archive + rewrite, but we add an explicit rule
    // to be extra safe across updates and permalink settings.
    add_rewrite_rule('^decks/?$', 'index.php?post_type=decks', 'top');
    add_rewrite_rule('^decks/page/([0-9]{1,})/?$', 'index.php?post_type=decks&paged=$matches[1]', 'top');
}, 20);

// One-time upgrade routines on version changes (flush rewrites and migrate legacy deck assignments).
add_action('admin_init', function() {
    $stored = get_option('wplc_plugin_version');
    if ($stored === WP_LEARNING_CARDS_VERSION) {
        return;
    }

    // Attempt to migrate legacy note-level deck assignments into the per-card assignment table.
    if (function_exists('wplc_migrate_note_deck_meta_to_card_decks')) {
        wplc_migrate_note_deck_meta_to_card_decks();
    }

    // Flush rewrites once (important so /decks works after updates, not just fresh activation).
    add_action('shutdown', function() {
        flush_rewrite_rules(false);
    });

    update_option('wplc_plugin_version', WP_LEARNING_CARDS_VERSION);
});



// 1. Enable archive for decks
add_action('init', 'setup_deck_archive');
function setup_deck_archive() {
    global $wp_post_types;
    if (isset($wp_post_types['decks'])) {
        $wp_post_types['decks']->has_archive = true;
       // $wp_post_types['decks']->rewrite = array('slug' => 'study');
    }
}

// 2. Load custom template
add_filter('template_include', 'deck_archive_template');
function deck_archive_template($template) {
    if (is_post_type_archive('decks')) {
        $plugin_dir = WP_LEARNING_CARDS_DIR;
        $custom_template = $plugin_dir . 'archive-decks.php';

        if (!file_exists($custom_template)) {
            create_deck_archive_file(); // make sure this writes a valid template
        }

        if (file_exists($custom_template)) {
            return $custom_template;
        }
    }


    return $template;
}

// Activation and deactivation hooks

function wplc_activate_plugin() {
    // Core tables (progress/reviews/sessions/settings + global suspensions)
    if (function_exists('create_flashcard_progress_tables')) {
        create_flashcard_progress_tables();
    }

    // Deck auto-assignment rules table
    if (function_exists('create_deck_rules_table')) {
        create_deck_rules_table();
    }

    // Ensure deck archive is configured
    if (function_exists('setup_deck_archive')) {
        setup_deck_archive();
    }

    flush_rewrite_rules();
}

register_activation_hook(__FILE__, 'wplc_activate_plugin');

register_deactivation_hook(__FILE__, function() {
    flush_rewrite_rules();
});

/**
 * One-time migration: older installs stored deck assignment on the note (_card_deck) only.
 * The new unified "Browse Cards" tooling relies on the per-card assignment table.
 * We migrate note-level assignments to per-template rows IF the assignment table is empty.
 */
function wplc_migrate_note_deck_meta_to_card_decks() {
    global $wpdb;

    $card_decks_table = $wpdb->prefix . 'flashcard_card_decks';

    // Ensure table exists
    $table_exists = $wpdb->get_var($wpdb->prepare("SHOW TABLES LIKE %s", $card_decks_table));
    if ($table_exists !== $card_decks_table) {
        if (function_exists('create_flashcard_progress_tables')) {
            create_flashcard_progress_tables();
        }
    }

    // If there are already assignments, don't touch anything.
    $existing = (int) $wpdb->get_var("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM $card_decks_table");
    if ($existing > 0) {
        return;
    }

    // Build template map: note_type_id => [template_id...]
    $templates = get_posts([
        'post_type'   => 'card_templates',
        'numberposts' => -1,
        'post_status' => 'publish',
    ]);
    $tpl_by_type = [];
    foreach ($templates as $tpl) {
        $type_id = absint(get_post_meta($tpl->ID, '_template_card_type', true));
        if (!$type_id) { continue; }
        if (!isset($tpl_by_type[$type_id])) { $tpl_by_type[$type_id] = []; }
        $tpl_by_type[$type_id][] = (int) $tpl->ID;
    }

    // Find notes with a deck assignment.
    $notes = get_posts([
        'post_type'   => 'notes',
        'numberposts' => -1,
        'post_status' => 'publish',
        'fields'      => 'ids',
        'meta_query'  => [
            [
                'key'     => '_card_deck',
                'compare' => 'EXISTS',
            ]
        ],
    ]);

    foreach ($notes as $note_id) {
        $note_id = absint($note_id);
        if (!$note_id) { continue; }

        $deck_id = absint(get_post_meta($note_id, '_card_deck', true));
        if (!$deck_id) { continue; }

        $type_id = absint(get_post_meta($note_id, '_card_type', true));
        if (!$type_id || empty($tpl_by_type[$type_id])) { continue; }

        foreach ($tpl_by_type[$type_id] as $template_id) {
            $wpdb->insert(
                $card_decks_table,
                [
                    'note_id'     => $note_id,
                    'template_id' => (int) $template_id,
                    'deck_id'     => $deck_id,
                    'created_at'  => current_time('mysql'),
                ],
                ['%d','%d','%d','%s']
            );
        }
    }
}
